sources.title: Embassy of Grenada: Visitors
sources.officialityEvidence: Grenada's live embassy visitor page states that requirements turn on citizenship and currently links the complete country visa-requirements schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visa requirements for travel to Grenada are based on your country of citizenship.

sources.title: Embassy of Grenada: Visa Requirements for Traveling to Grenada
sources.officialityEvidence: The currently linked official embassy nationality schedule is marked Updated April 2024, expressly lists Angola as Prior to Arrival, and defines that term as a visa obtained at a Grenadian mission or consulate before travel.

sources.title: Suspension of visa issuance to foreign nationals
sources.officialityEvidence: The current State Department notice implements Presidential Proclamation 10998 from 1 January 2026 and expressly names Angola in the partial suspension for B-1/B-2 visitor visas.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The Department of State partially suspended visa issuance ... Angola.

sources.title: 8 U.S.C. 1101: Definitions
sources.publisher: Office of the Law Revision Counsel, U.S. House of Representatives
sources.officialityEvidence: The official current U.S. Code compilation defines the INA's geographical United States to include Puerto Rico, Guam, the U.S. Virgin Islands, and CNMI.
sources.supportingExcerpt: means the continental United States, Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, Guam, the Virgin Islands ... and the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands

policies.title: Angolan ordinary passports: Grenada advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Grenada's currently linked official nationality schedule lists Angola as Prior to Arrival, which its glossary defines as obtaining a visa at a Grenadian mission or consulate before travel.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Angolan passport holder travelling for a short visitor stay; the schedule requires the visa before travel rather than at the port of entry.
The schedule is marked Updated April 2024 and is actively linked by Grenada's current embassy visitor page; recheck if it is replaced.
Work, residence, study, other purposes, carrier requirements and final admission remain outside this classification.
